run_eval_coco_retrieval: run the COCO image-caption retrieval evaluation script with pretrained multimodal BERT model
test_evaluate: test the evaluate function that computes retrieval metrics r1, r5, r10, medr, meanr on a multimodal BERT model
review_main: review the main function that parses CLI args, loads dataset, initializes model, and runs evaluation
